inlines.v: TUR'KY, noun [As this fowl was not brought from Turkey, it would be more correct to write the name turky ] A large fowl, the Meleagris gallopavo, a distinct genus. It is a native of America, and its flesh furnishes most delicious food. Wild turkies abound in the forests of America, and domestic turkies are bred in other countries, as well as in America.
